description:
My high school sweetheart and my father's suicide due to business failure. Yeonwoo believes that his love makes others unhappy. As usual, when he tries to save his one-night stand at a gay bar, he runs into Minhyuk, who resembles his past lover. Yeonwoo gradually seeps into Minhyuk, who fills his lonely life, but he feels a coldness in him, who is kind in everything.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000058748), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12205234), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hand_hand)
